title: Nexus Chat
description: The Nexus Tools assistant: it looks up items, places and listings, and acts on your account with your approval.
signInTitle: Sign in to use Nexus Chat
signInBody: The assistant acts on your Nexus Tools account: you need to be signed in.
emptyTitle: What can I do for you?
emptyHint: Look up an item, a place or a listing, or ask me to sort your inventory. I ask for your approval before any change.

suggestions.find: Where can I buy an Arrowhead rifle?
suggestions.inventory: How much Quantainium is in my inventory?

placeholderApproval: Confirm or decline above, or write a message…
stoppedBudget: The answer stopped: this month's budget is used up.
loadFailed: The chat could not be loaded.

budget.label: This month's budget
budget.exhausted: Your budget for this month is used up. It resets on {date}.

access.failed: The request could not be sent. Try again.

none.title: Nexus Chat is invite-only
none.body: The assistant searches Nexus Tools and acts on your account (inventory, orders, contributions). Request access: an administrator opens it and sets your monthly budget.

requested.title: Request sent
requested.body: An administrator still has to open your access. Check back a little later.

revoked.title: Access not open
revoked.body: Your access to Nexus Chat is not open. Contact an administrator if you think this is a mistake.

disabled.title: Nexus Chat is closed
disabled.body: The assistant is closed for now. Check back later.

names.contribute_official_event_edit: Proposing a correction to the event
names.list_players_in_game: Looking for your friends in game
names.blueprint_owners_in_org: Finding members who own the blueprint
names.propose_private_place: Proposing the private place to the public
names.list_shares: Reading who it is shared with
names.list_missing: Reading what's missing in the catalog

errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.disabled: Nexus Chat is closed for now.
errors.no_access: Your access to Nexus Chat is not open.
errors.budget_exhausted: Your budget for this month is used up.
errors.invalid_request: This message could not be sent (too long, or the conversation changed). Open the conversation again.
errors.not_found: This conversation could not be found.
errors.busy: Another answer is still in progress (on the site, the app or the overlay). Try again in a moment.
errors.unavailable: The Nexus Tools tools are not responding. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: The answer was interrupted. Try again.

voice.talkHint: Talk to Nexus Chat: hold and release to send, or press once to start and once to finish. In game, hold the "Talk to Nexus Chat" shortcut.
voice.readAloudOff: Answers not read aloud (click to hear them)

errors.mic_failed: The microphone could not open. Check that one is plugged in and allowed in Windows settings.
errors.mic_in_use: The microphone is already in use by the other Nexus Chat window.
errors.mic_silent: The microphone picked up nothing (complete silence). Check the microphone chosen in the app's settings, and in Windows Settings › Privacy › Microphone that desktop apps may use it.
errors.nothing_heard: I didn't hear anything. Try again a little louder.
errors.too_short: Too short: hold the key while you speak.
errors.too_long: Too long: one minute at most per question.
errors.voice_disabled: Voice is not available right now.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.disabled: Nexus Chat is closed for now.
errors.no_access: Your access to Nexus Chat is not open.
errors.budget_exhausted: Your budget for this month is used up.
errors.invalid_request: The recording could not be read.
errors.busy: Another answer is still in progress. Try again in a moment.
errors.unavailable: Voice is not responding. Try again in a moment.
